package postgres

import (
	"context"
	"errors"
	"testing"

	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/domain/repository"
	"github.com/jackc/pgx/v5"
	"github.com/jackc/pgx/v5/pgconn"
)

type txTestRunner struct{}

func (txTestRunner) Exec(context.Context, string, ...any) (pgconn.CommandTag, error) {
	return pgconn.CommandTag{}, nil
}
func (txTestRunner) Query(context.Context, string, ...any) (pgx.Rows, error) { return nil, nil }
func (txTestRunner) QueryRow(context.Context, string, ...any) pgx.Row        { return nil }

type txTestBeginner struct {
	tx    *txTestPGX
	begun int
}

func (b *txTestBeginner) Begin(context.Context) (pgx.Tx, error) {
	b.begun++
	return b.tx, nil
}

type txTestPGX struct {
	pgx.Tx
	commits   int
	rollbacks int
}

func (tx *txTestPGX) Commit(context.Context) error {
	tx.commits++
	return nil
}

func (tx *txTestPGX) Rollback(context.Context) error {
	tx.rollbacks++
	return nil
}

func TestTxManagerReusesExistingTransaction(t *testing.T) {
	runner := txTestRunner{}
	ctx := context.WithValue(context.Background(), txKey{}, DBRunner(runner))
	called := false

	err := (TxManagerPG{}).WithTx(ctx, func(nested repository.Context) error {
		called = true
		if getRunner(nested, nil) != runner {
			t.Fatal("nested transaction did not preserve the existing runner")
		}
		return nil
	})

	if err != nil || !called {
		t.Fatalf("nested transaction failed: called=%v err=%v", called, err)
	}
}

func TestTxManagerRunsCallbacksOnlyAfterCommit(t *testing.T) {
	tx := &txTestPGX{}
	beginner := &txTestBeginner{tx: tx}
	callbackCalled := false

	err := (TxManagerPG{Pool: beginner}).WithTx(context.Background(), func(ctx repository.Context) error {
		if !repository.DeferAfterCommit(ctx, func() { callbackCalled = true }) {
			t.Fatal("callback was not deferred")
		}
		if callbackCalled {
			t.Fatal("callback ran before commit")
		}
		return nil
	})

	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("transaction failed: %v", err)
	}
	if beginner.begun != 1 || tx.commits != 1 || !callbackCalled {
		t.Fatalf("unexpected transaction state: begun=%d commits=%d callback=%v", beginner.begun, tx.commits, callbackCalled)
	}
}

func TestTxManagerDiscardsCallbacksOnRollback(t *testing.T) {
	tx := &txTestPGX{}
	callbackCalled := false
	expected := errors.New("stop")

	err := (TxManagerPG{Pool: &txTestBeginner{tx: tx}}).WithTx(context.Background(), func(ctx repository.Context) error {
		repository.DeferAfterCommit(ctx, func() { callbackCalled = true })
		return expected
	})

	if !errors.Is(err, expected) {
		t.Fatalf("unexpected error: %v", err)
	}
	if tx.commits != 0 || tx.rollbacks != 1 || callbackCalled {
		t.Fatalf("rollback leaked work: commits=%d rollbacks=%d callback=%v", tx.commits, tx.rollbacks, callbackCalled)
	}
}
